head: codex/closure-terminal-lineage-20261012
title: fix: authenticate natural Assurance and reconcile failure terminal debt
body:
Natural Sentinel repository_dispatch was rejected by the causal Assurance binder, failed external-clock Assurance lacked an authenticated recovery parent, and the operating collector permanently replayed PR2655 terminal-null history. Authenticate actual natural-clock intake and exact Sentinel archive lineage; export fresh signed consistent-read plus pinned S3 body/version/retention/KMS readback after failure-terminal ACK; consume protected native FINALIZER evidence with original reservation tuple and merge ancestry. Reuse historic recovery sources across later main commits without reconsumption.

Validation: 165 targeted regression and negative tests passed, including manual/replayed clock, archive/source drift, missing/changed ACK, approval collisions, and historical-source ancestry/main drift rejection. Success Authority Gate contract validation passed. Root reviewed the separate failed-clock implementation; Red Team independently reviewed the binder and terminal changes. Exact-head isolated native verification remains required.

Failure recovery reconciles only original terminal debt: actual_authority_granted=false and platform_closure=false. It cannot establish normal eligible landing, whole authority, two full natural chains, or promotion. Historic GitHub evidence lookup is bounded to 1000 runs and requires unexpired protected archives; exhaustion or expiry stays fail-closed. Production/Public/G5/provider HOLD. No manual runtime dispatch, duplicate deployment or original reservation reconsume.

Rollback: revert this bounded consumer/verification change through the same protected path; immutable original/recovery records remain preserved.

autonomous_effect: restore authenticated natural recovery and exact-source evidence consumption.
global_effect: preserve partitioned bounded read-only evidence collection.
irreplaceable_value_effect: retain original signed reservation and immutable terminal lineage.
